build_llamalike_transformer: build a Llama-like transformer model from a configuration object with JAX parameters
build_llamalike_feedforward: build a feedforward block with SwiGLU or GeGLU gated linear unit variants
build_llamalike_attention: build an attention block supporting multi-query, grouped-query, or standard attention
build_llamalike_block: build a transformer decoder block with pre-norm attention and feedforward residual sublayers
llamalike_from_huggingface_model: convert a HuggingFace Llama-like model to a Penzai transformer with loaded weights
